title: Breach Tablets 'of the Invasion' (extra rares)
summary: Roll Breach Tablets for the 'of the Invasion' suffix (Unstable Breaches spawn 1–2 additional Rare Monsters when Stabilised) with a monster-effectiveness or item-rarity prefix, and sell them to juiced Breach farmers. 0.5.5 cut the suffix from 1–3 to 1–2.

budget.why: Breach Tablets and Transmutation/Augmentation orbs; a Divine Orb only to push a finished roll to 2.
budget.build_needs: None for the rolling; Breach Tablets come from ordinary maps.

claim.note: Our reading of the method against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No combat: the method is rolling in the stash and selling.

claim.note: Not rated: the build scale measures map content, and this method has none.

complexity.why: The complexity scale is written for map setups, not for rolling at the stash.

claim.note: Not rated: no step of the scale describes a rolling loop.

durability.why_it_works: The 'of the Invasion' suffix adds 1–2 rare monsters to each stabilised Unstable Breach, and Breach rewards come from those monsters.
breaks_when: The suffix is cut again (0.5.5 already cut it from 1–3)
Breach rare rewards fall in value

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.
Base BreachAugment: 'Adds an Otherworldy Breach to a Map', 10 uses. A magic tablet holds one prefix and one suffix; a rare one has room for both suffixes below.

target_mods.text: Unstable Breaches in Map spawn (1–2) additional Rare Monsters when Stabilised

claim.note: Suffix 'of the Invasion' (RePoE TowerBreachAdditionalRares). 0.5.5 cut it from 1–3 to 1–2 and spawns the rares in waves of 5; a (2–5) roll belongs to the unique tablet Wraeclast Besieged, not this suffix.

Suffix 'of Undertaking' (RePoE TowerMapAdditionalModifier), on every tablet base. trade2 files the stat under its singular wording, which RePoE's tablet stat descriptions give the same stat. ASaVeQ's jackpot (5:37) pairs it with the extra-rares suffix and effectiveness.

target_mods.text: (8–12)% increased Rarity of Items found in Map

roll_steps.action: Buy rare Breach Tablets that already carry the 'of the Invasion' suffix and reroll the other mods with Chaos Orbs, aiming at monster effectiveness and an additional-modifiers suffix. The older route is Transmutation and Augmentation on magic bases.

claim.note: Creator method (ASaVeQ, 2026-07-24): current route at 8:16–8:42, older magic route at 7:33, jackpot at 5:37. The video predates the 0.5.5 cut to 1–2.

roll_steps.action: Divine Orb toward 2 additional rares (the 0.5.5 maximum), before anything corrupts the tablet.

claim.note: A Divine Orb randomises modifier values; an Ancient Infuser corrupts the tablet, after which it cannot be rerolled.

demand.why: Juiced Breach farms (Wombgifts, Hiveblood) want more stabilised rares per Breach.

claim.note: Creator demand from before 0.5.5 (ASaVeQ 2026-07-24, 9:24 'you always want three'): that was the 1–3 version, so no price is repeated here.

risks: 0.5.5 cut the suffix to 1–2 additional rares: older videos and prices describe the 1–3 version.
Tablets are not on the currency exchange: price on the trade site with the Search link.
